latvia.description: On October 28th, at the Splendid Palace cinema in Rīga, the Entrepreneurs for Peace Foundation (Fonds “Uzņēmēji mieram”) and microsurgeon Olafs Libermanis were awarded the Order of St. Panteleimon of Ukraine for their significant contribution to supporting Ukraine.

latvia.title: Reconstructed Zemitāni bridge proves not very disability-friendly
latvia.description: Tactile guide strips that come up against a post, gaps in the handrails, and lift doors that cannot be closed – this was the scene that greeted the disability association “Apeirons” when they visited the Jorģis Zemitāns Bridge, the reconstruction of which was completed just a month ago, Latvian Television reported on October 28.

latvia.title: Traffic restrictions in November in Rīga
latvia.description: During the upcoming national holiday celebrations in November, there will be several traffic restrictions in Rīga from 9 November onwards. Certain public transport routes will be shortened or rerouted, whilst gatherings will be prohibited on the Vanšu Bridge, said Rīga City Council.

latvia.title: Possible Cabinet outline shaping up in Latvia
latvia.description: As official coalition talks get underway, the outlines of the possible distribution of posts in the next government are also beginning to emerge, according to a report on Wednesday evening by the Latvian Television programme “Panorāma”.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 28th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: airBaltic to sack 100 pilots, 200 flight attendants
latvia.description: The national airline ‘airBaltic’ plans to make around 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew members redundant. This was announced by the Latvian Aviation Trade Union (LAA). From Saturday, staff will begin to receive information on whether their employment contracts will be renewed. “airBaltic” has confirmed the planned number of redundancies, Latvian Television reports on Wednesday, October 28.

latvia.title: Swedbank announces Baltic job losses
latvia.description: Swedbank is laying off around 100 staff in the Baltic states, while the bank says Artificial Intelligence (AI) could lead to further layoffs in future, reports ERR News in Estonia.

latvia.title: Mārtiņš Kazāks: Turning Europe's scale into impact
latvia.description: Europe has a peculiar problem. As one of the world's largest economies, we have the talent, capital, technology, and market size to compete. Yet we struggle to turn these advantages into economic success. Our companies face barriers to expansion, our savings fail to finance innovation, and productivity growth has disappointed for decades.

latvia.title: Foreign diplomats to be taken to Rēzekne for investment pep talk
latvia.description: On 30th October, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in cooperation with the Latgale Planning Region, is organising a regional visit to Rēzekne for diplomats from foreign embassies, the Ministry said.

latvia.title: Writer, journalist Rimants Ziedonis passes away
latvia.description: The writer and journalist Rimants Ziedonis (1962–2026) has passed away, his daughter Evelīna Ziedone announced on social media.

latvia.title: Latvian Prime Minister's advisor detained by law enforcement
latvia.description: Law enforcement authorities have detained Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' advisor on public administration issues Mārtiņš Brencis, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Two flags pulled down from Rīga bridge within two weeks
latvia.description: On Wednesday morning, a Saudi Arabian flag was removed from the cables of the Vanšu Bridge, according to Ieva Lukaža-Apalupa, chief communications officer at the Riga Municipal Police (RPP), and newswire LETA.

latvia.title: 6 million euro competition announced for Latvian defence research
latvia.description: The Latvian Science Council (LZP) has announced an open call for project applications for the "Defence Innovation Research Programme" for 2026–2029.

latvia.title: Eleven money mules detained in October in Latvia
latvia.description: In October this year, the State Police arrested eleven ‘money mules’ and couriers. Among those arrested are both young people who have not yet reached legal age or have only recently done so, and a man of retirement age who has also committed crimes abroad, the State Police said in a statement.

latvia.title: Lending is on the rise, says Latvian central bank
latvia.description: A new report from the Latvian central bank says lending activity has grown "significantly" but that there is still room for further growth in the market.

latvia.title: FICIL wants bolder decisions from Latvian government
latvia.description: The new government must take bolder decisions, according to the opinion of the leadership of the Foreign Investors’ Council in Latvia (FICIL). At present, uncertainty over migration issues and the lack of concrete plans are causing concern, Latvian Radio reported on October 28.

latvia.title: First market manipulation case in Latvia's history goes to court
latvia.description: For the first time in Latvia’s history, individuals are being tried for market manipulation. The defendants do not admit their guilt in carrying out fictitious transactions designed to inflate share turnover on the stock exchange and thereby gain an additional sum of more than 100,000 euros. The prosecutor is asking the court to impose fines totalling several tens of thousands of euros on the defendants for these actions, Latvian Television reported on October 28.

latvia.title: Citizenship scandal puts Latvia's 'golden visa' scheme back in spotlight
latvia.description: The controversy involving the giving and then taking away of Latvian citizenship to an Indian citizen is developing in another direction, too, with Latvia's so-called "golden visa" scheme in the spotlight.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 27th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: 'Occasional' transport ban to Russia, Belarus extended in Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 27 October, the government decided to extend the ban on occasional passenger bus services to Russia and Belarus by one year. The government had already banned such services for one year last year.

latvia.title: Vidzeme has Latvia's highest fertility rate
latvia.description: Among Latvia's regions, Vidzeme is the most fertile – at least if you are a woman – according to fresh Eurostat data published on October 27th.

latvia.title: Scientist at centre of Latvian citizenship scandal complains to police
latvia.description: An Indian scientist who finds herself at the centre of an accelerating scandal in Latvia over her application for Latvian citizenship has turned to the police alleging that she is the victim of harassment and misinformation, with racist overtones.

latvia.title: How 'sweet sausage' came about in Latvia
latvia.description: In the Latvian Radio 3 series ‘Did you know?’, cultural researchers, historians and other experts explain a wide variety of terms, report on interesting artefacts and share unusual ideas. This time, food researcher Astra Spalvēna tells the story of the recipe of 'sweet sausage'.

latvia.title: A lot of intoxicated teens at Rīga Children's Hospital this autumn
latvia.description: Compared with last year, the number of teenagers who have consumed intoxicating substances and been admitted to hospital has doubled this autumn, according to information published by the Children’s Clinical University Hospital (BKUS) on October 27.

latvia.title: What's life like as a food delivery courier in Latvia?
latvia.description: Couriers with large delivery bags on bicycles are a common sight in Latvia's largest cities and a constant source of speculation. So Latvian Television's programme "Aizliegtais panēmiens" ('Forbidden Method') decided to look behind the rumours at the specifics of such work, what happens in the community, what the competition is like, and how they are taxed.

latvia.title: Swedish Cemvision to produce cement in Ventspils, Latvia
latvia.description: The “RE-MENT” project by the Swedish company “Cemvision” has been selected to receive funding of up to 27.5 million euros from the European Union’s Innovation Fund for the construction of a commercial-scale low-emission cement plant in Ventspils, the Latvian Investment and Development Agency (LIAA) said in a release on Tuesday.

latvia.title: Latvia helps to provide 'Battlefield Taxis' for the Bundeswehr
latvia.description: In Germany, production of the Bundeswehr’s new standard armoured personnel carrier is getting under way, while in Latvia essentially the same vehicle is already being manufactured.

latvia.title: Latvia's blood reserves running low
latvia.description: Blood stocks in Latvia have once again fallen significantly. The National Blood Donor Centre (VADC) is calling on anyone who is able and willing to donate blood to come forward. In order to reach as many donors as possible, mobile blood collection units are also scheduled to visit many towns and settlements across Latvia, Latvian Television reports.

latvia.title: Latvian parliament revamps its website
latvia.description: The website of Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, (saeima.lv) has adopted a new design, the goal of which is to make information about the work of the parliament easier to find and more accessible, as well as to provide a more convenient opportunity to follow and participate in the work of the Saeima.

latvia.title: Lithuanian minister hopes new government will help Latvia catch up on Rail Baltica
latvia.description: Lithuanian Transport Minister Juras Taminskas said on Monday that he hopes the installation of a new government in Latvia will improve cooperation on the troubled Rail Baltica project, reports Lithuanian public media LRT.

latvia.title: Upstairs, downstairs: life returns to historic Bebrene Manor
latvia.description: The historic cellars, underground tunnel and terrace of Bebrene Manor have undergone transformations, becoming new cultural spaces for the local community and visitors to the manor, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Grim road death statistics over past weekend in Latvia
latvia.description: Speeding, not wearing a seatbelt and drink-driving are the three most common factors leading to fatalities on the roads. The Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD) points out that this year’s grim road accident statistics are particularly marked by tragedies where the main cause is driving at extremely high speeds. Five people lost their lives in road accidents last weekend, Latvian Television reported on Monday, October 26.

latvia.title: Tree friends hope to make more tree friends in western Latvia campaign
latvia.description: In Kurzeme, local authority representatives, arborists and other interested parties are being taught to recognise the habitats of protected species in historic tree-lined avenues and parks. This is one of the public education initiatives taking place as part of the Latvian-Lithuanian cross-border project ‘Green Guardians’, Latvian Radio reported on October 27.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 26th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvian Academy of Sciences to consider citizenship scandal
latvia.description: In one month, on November 26th, the Latvian Academy of Sciences (LAS) will hold a plenary meeting, at which it is planned to discuss the possible resignation of the academy's president Ivars Kalviņš in connection with his recommendation to grant Latvian citizenship to Indian citizen Divya Kannan Vishwanath.

latvia.title: Young Latvians consider themselves to be healthy, but not THAT healthy
latvia.description: In 2025, 89.7% of young people aged 16 to 29 in the European Union perceived their health as good or very good. This was far higher than the share in the total population aged 16 and over, at 67.9%.

latvia.title: Power line protection zones not such a livewire issue
latvia.description: The expansion of protection zones around power lines with a nominal voltage of 110 kilovolts (kV), which was agreed by the Saeima this month, is a less hot issue than other cases affecting forests, said Jānis Rozītis, Chairman of the Board of the World Wide Fund for Nature and Head of the Forest Programme, in a discussion on the Latvian Radio show "How to Live Better".

latvia.title: Driver hit with big fine after providing conclusive evidence against self
latvia.description: The Zemgale Regional Court has imposed a fine of 680 euros and a 12-month driving ban on a driver who was filmed driving at 240 kilometres per hour on public roads.

latvia.title: When cows fly: Rīga Airport tries out live cattle export
latvia.description: This month, live cattle were exported from Rīga to Central Asian countries on two trial flights. On these flights, 240 young cattle from Estonia were exported via Riga Airport to Tashkent Airport, Latvian Radio reported on October 26.

latvia.title: CERT: Latvia has dodged hundreds of hacker attacks recently
latvia.description: Over the last few days, there have been hundreds of attempts to hack Latvian websites, but none of these cyber-attack attempts have been successful. Latvian Radio obtained this information from CERT.lv, the cyber incident response centre.

latvia.title: More ideas floated for new Latvian national football stadium
latvia.description: In order to build a modern football arena for international matches, the idea of ​​rebuilding the existing "Skonto" stadium will most likely have to be abandoned, reported LTV's De Facto investigative show on October 25th.

latvia.title: Winter tyres should be on your car about now, say experts
latvia.description: Although there haven’t been many cold and wet days so far this autumn, drivers should already be thinking about changing from summer tyres to winter tyres. Experts interviewed by Latvian Television recommend not putting it off until December and choosing the time to change tyres according to the weather conditions, rather than waiting until winter tyres become compulsory. In Latvia, they must be used from 1 December to 1 March.

latvia.title: Cooler air will come to Latvia early November
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will remain warm this week.

latvia.title: Latvian statistics office warns about bogus surveys
latvia.description: Latvia's Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) has issued advice to the public in case they are contacted by people impersonating genuine statisticians.

latvia.title: Winners of 13th Riga International Film Festival named
latvia.description: The winners of the Riga International Film Festival (RIGA IFF) competitions and industry programme were honoured at a festive ceremony hosted by director and actor Gerds Lapoška on October 24th.

latvia.title: Prognozēto siltuma tarifa kāpums Rīgā izdevies samazināt, taču daba visu var mainīt
latvia.description: Prognozēto siltuma tarifa kāpumu Rīgā ir izdevies samazināt, lai pieaugums nesasniegtu iepriekš lēstos 30%, tomēr aprēķinos ir iekļautas arī optimistiskas prognozes, kurām nepiepildoties tarifa kāpums būs lielāks, ceturtdien pēc Ministru kabineta rīcības apspriedes enerģētikas jautājumos žurnālistiem stāstīja politiķi. Ministru prezidents Andris Kulbergs (AS) atzīmēja, ka AS “Rīgas siltums” iepriekš bija prognozējis tarifu kāpumu šajā ziemas […]

lithuania.description: Government seeks to attract private investment as defence spending rises

lithuania.title: FIRST AID: Lithuania eyes pharma dependence
lithuania.description: In today's edition: tobacco, digital health, disinformation

lithuania.title: Lithuanian presidency to put pharma at heart of EU security push
lithuania.description: Europe braces for a so-called 'China Shock 2.0'

lithuania.title: E5 format gains traction in Europe’s security architecture
lithuania.description: The five European powers reaffirm support for Ukraine and commit to stronger defence capabilities within NATO

lithuania.title: Mbappé-balhé után Hello Kitty-botrány – ezúttal a japán Sanriónak kellett bocsánatot kérnie a komplett kínai néptől
lithuania.description: Együttműködtek egy japán tévésorozattal, amelyben kínai ügynökök folyamodtak kegyetlen módszerekhez.

lithuania.title: Egyetlen szó miatt kényszerült térdre a Real Madrid és Kylian Mbappé – Szabad diktátornak neveznünk egy diktátort?
lithuania.description: Kylian Mbappé egy videóban a róla készült kedvenc mémjének azt nevezte, amelyen az arcát egy kínai diktátoréra montírozták. A képen a több tízmillió ember haláláért felelős Mao Ce-tung látható. Peking reakciója nem maradt el: több kínai cég azonnal felbontotta szerződését a francia csatárral, az állami televízió pedig felfüggesztette a spanyol bajnokság közvetítését. A hatalmas kínai piac elvesztésétől tartva előbb a LaLiga vezetője, Javier Tebas, majd maga Mbappé és a Real Madrid is bocsánatot kért a kínai néptől. Az eset jól mutatja, mennyire érzékeny Kína a történelmi kérdésekre, és meddig hajlandók elmenni a nyugati szereplők az üzleti érdekeik védelmében.

lithuania.title: Konfliktusforrásból versenyelőny: tudatos stratégiát igényel a több generációs munkavállalói közösség hatékony irányítása
lithuania.description: A legtöbb munkahelyen már három-négy generáció dolgozik együtt, eltérő tapasztalatokkal, kommunikációs szokásokkal és vezetői elvárásokkal. Ez lehet konfliktusforrás, de komoly versenyelőny is – attól függően, hogy a szervezet tudatosan kezeli-e a különbségeket. Erről az immár jelenséggé duzzadt kérdéskörről beszélgettünk Bereczki Enikővel , generációkutatóval, a Mentor-Szanator Kft. ügyvezető tulajdonosával. A témával részletesen is foglalkozunk a Portfolio HR (R)evolution 2026 konferencián , ahol Enikő szintén az előadók között szerepel. Támogatott tartalom

lithuania.title: Ukraina straci ważnego sojusznika? W tle chęć przypodobania się Rosji
lithuania.description: Tylko oficjalne, osobiste przeprosiny ze strony Wołodymyra Zełenskiego mogą zakończyć ten spór - mówi TVN24+ Oskar Pietrewicz, ekspert do spraw koreańskich. W relacjach Ukrainy z Koreą Południową wybuchł niespodziewany kryzys, w którego tle są Korea Północna i Rosja.

lithuania.title: Lampa z panelem solarnym i kamera na drzewie na cmentarzu. "Ktoś jest mocno kreatywny"
lithuania.description: Niecodzienny widok na cmentarzu w Łodzi. Do drzewa ktoś zamontował lampę z panelem solarnym i kamerę. Zarządca nekropolii mówi nam, że nikt z nim tego nie konsultował i zażąda usunięcia elementów z drzewa. Zdania wśród mieszkańców są natomiast podzielone. - Ale jak to do drzewa i po co zmarłemu jeszcze ta lampa - mówiła jedna z mieszkanek. Spotkany mężczyzna powiedział z kolei, "że ktoś jest mocno kreatywny".

lithuania.title: Kampaň americké senátorky se objevila na opačném konci země, zadavatel si spletl města
lithuania.description: Republikánská senátorka za americký stát Maine se před listopadovými volbami jasně vymezuje vůči demokratickému protikandidátovi a zcela jasně to deklarovala i v nedávné kampani šířené prostřednictvím digitálních platforem. Ta však omylem mířila k lidem na opačném pobřeží Spojených států.

lithuania.title: De ce vrea Trump excluderea din alegeri a unei candidate democrate pentru Senatul SUA. Controversa „Sullivan”
lithuania.description: Preşedintele american Donald Trump a cerut descalificarea din alegeri a democratei Mary Peltola, care candidează la un mandat în Senat în Alaska, în urma unor dezvăluiri ale cotidianului The New York Times (NYT), potrivit cărora campania sa a determinat un bărbat cu acelaşi nume ca al senatorului republican în exerciţiu, Dan Sullivan, să candideze pentru a dilua votul republicanilor.

lithuania.title: „Fiul lui Călin Georgescu a câștigat Balonul de Aur”. O postare ironică pe TikTok, virală în rândul susținătorilor: „Așa tată, așa fiu”
lithuania.description: Călin Georgescu, chiar și aflat în spatele gratiilor, se bucură de o susținere necondiționată din partea așa-zișilor suveraniști. Dragostea absolută se reflectă chiar și asupra familiei inculpatului. Comentariile de susținere curg la majoritatea postărilor care-l vizează pe fostul candidat. Așa se face că o postare tip pamflet de pe TikTok în care se anunța că „fiul său a câștigat Balonul de Aur” a ajuns virală și a adunat zeci de mii de vizualizări și mii de aprecieri. Anterior, fiul era „campion” la înot.

lithuania.title: Cine ar putea conduce Serbia după înfrângerea lui Aleksandar Vucic. Un cardiolog și o legendă a baschetului, pe lista studenților
lithuania.description: După ce o mișcare de protest condusă de studenți l-a înlăturat de la putere pe fostul președinte al Serbiei, Aleksandar Vucic, în urma alegerilor anticipate de duminică, țara așteaptă să afle cine va ocupa funcția de prim-ministru și alte posturi-cheie din viitorul guvern. Printre numele vehiculate pe lista studenților se numără un fost guvernator al băncii centrale, un cardiolog, o fostă vedetă a baschetului și un profesor de chimie, potrivit Reuters.

lithuania.title: Linia de Apărare a Țărilor Baltice: un stat NATO va construi 150 de buncăre la granița cu Rusia
lithuania.description: În județul estonian Ida-Virumaa, situat la granița cu Rusia, vor fi construite 150 de buncăre în cadrul proiectului de creare a Liniei de Apărare a Țărilor Baltice. 100 dintre acestea vor fi amplasate pe terenuri de stat, iar alte 50 — pe terenuri municipale sau private, a declarat ministrul apărării al republicii, Martin Hereem, potrivit ERR.

lithuania.title: „Sub nicio formă.” Ce spune Petrișor Peiu despre o eventuală alianță AUR – PSD
lithuania.description: Liderilor senatorilor AUR Petrișor Peiu exclude o colaborare de tip coaliție cu PSD. „Colaborări punctuale vor fi cu toate partidele. Dar sub nicio formă nu vom avea o colaborare de tip alianță, coaliție cu PSD”, a declarat Petrișor Peiu pentru Digi24.

lithuania.title: După ce a fugit în SUA, Flavio Bolsonaro se proclamă „liderul Braziliei”
lithuania.description: Senatorul Flavio Bolsonaro s-a autoproclamat „adevăratul preşedinte” al Braziliei după ce a pierdut alegerile prezidenţiale de duminica trecută şi a fugit în Statele Unite, relatează The Guardian.

lithuania.title: Tragedie în Maramureș: O femeie a fost împușcată mortal cu o armă de vânătoare
lithuania.description: Accident mortal într-o pădure din Maramureș. O femeie a fost împușcată mortal cu o armă de vânătoare. Un bărbat a tras în direcția ei după ce ar fi confundat-o cu un animal.

lithuania.title: Ordine noi pentru brigada germană staționată în Lituania: monitorizarea exclavei Kaliningrad şi a Belarusului
lithuania.description: Brigada permanentă a Germaniei în Lituania va utiliza capacităţi de război electronic pentru a furniza o avertizare timpurie privind activităţile militare în desfăşurare în exclava rusă Kaliningrad şi în Belarusul vecin, a declarat şeful structurii cibernetice al armatei germane, citat de Reuters

lithuania.title: Precizările ANAF despre recuperarea datoriei de 14 milioane de lei de la PNL: Procedurile, aplicate în mod unitar, nediscriminatoriu
lithuania.description: Agenţia Naţională de Administrare Fiscală (ANAF) a transmis, miercuri seară, că recuperarea oricăror creanţe bugetare se face conform procedurilor legale, indiferent dacă debitorii sunt persoane fizice, persoane juridice sau partide politice. Procedura de recuperare a creanţelor bugetare presupune mai multe etape, iar executarea silită nu reprezintă singurul mecanism legal. Precizîrile vin în contextul în care preşedintele Autorităţii Electorale Permanente (AEP), Adrian Ţuţuianu, a declarat că AEP a fost în litigiu cu PNL pentru recuperarea sumei de 14 milioane de lei şi nu a putut proceda la executarea silită. El a precizat că a anunţat ANAF, după ce instanţa a dat hotărârea definitivă în dosar şi a adăugat că speră ca Agenţia Naţională de Administrare Fiscală să înceapă procedura de executare silită.

lithuania.title: Flavio Bolsonaro a ajuns în SUA pe o rută ocolitoare, după înfrângerea în alegerile prezidențiale din Brazilia
lithuania.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, fiul fostului președinte brazilian Jair Bolsonaro, a ajuns la Miami, după ce a părăsit Brazilia în urma înfrângerii în alegerile prezidențiale. Senatorul, vizat de mai multe anchete penale, a părăsit aeroportul sub escorta poliției, fără să facă declarații.

lithuania.title: O persoană din Caraș-Severin care a furat o armă de vânătoare şi 10 cartuşe este căutată cu drone şi camere cu termoviziune
lithuania.description: Poliţişti, jandarmi, voluntari şi un câine de urmă caută miercuri o persoană bănuită că a furat dintr-o locuinţă din satul Poiana Lungă, comuna Cornereva, judeţul Caraş-Severin, o armă de vânătoare şi zece cartuşe. Potrivit Inspectoratului Judeţean de Poliţie, pentru eficientizarea operaţiunilor, sunt utilizate drone şi camere cu termoviziune.

lithuania.title: Flavio Bolsonaro se îndreaptă spre Ecuador prin Argentina, după ce a părăsit Brazilia. Cum a ieșit din țară
lithuania.description: Senatorul conservator brazilian Flavio Bolsonaro şi familia sa se află în avion spre Ecuador, plecând din Argentina, după ce au părăsit Brazilia în urma înfrângerii sale la alegerile prezidenţiale, au declarat miercuri autorităţile argentiniene.

lithuania.title: Donald Trump Jr., la vânătoare în Mongolia cu un oligarh apropiat de Kremlin şi un alt rus aflat pe lista sancţiunilor americane (FT)
lithuania.description: Donald Trump Jr. a petrecut două zile în august 2026 la vânătoare în Mongolia cu Umar Kremlev, om de afaceri rus apropiat de structurile de securitate ale Kremlinului şi preşedinte al Asociaţiei Internaţionale de Box (IBA). Este acelaşi oligarh care a contribuit la finanţarea festivităţilor de nuntă ale lui Trump Jr., desfăşurate în mai, în Caraibe, deşi Donald Trump a susţinut ulterior că fiul său i-a rambursat banii, scrie Financial Times (FT), citată de News.ro.

lithuania.title: Ce sancțiune a primit un bărbat care şi-a pierdut cartuşele la o partidă de vânătoare. „Și-a lăsat ghiozdanul pe capotă și a plecat”
lithuania.description: Un bărbat din Teleorman a participat la o partidă de vânătoare în Buzău. La plecare, nu a observat că și-a lăsat în urmă centura de cartușe.

lithuania.title: Putin nu renunță la cucerirea regiunii ucrainene Donbas: „S-a atras atenția asupra politicilor conflictuale ale țărilor din UE și NATO”
lithuania.description: Președintele rus Vladimir Putin nu are de gând să renunțe la planurile sale de a cuceri în întregime regiunea Donbas, care include Donețk și Lugansk. El nu dorește să facă compromisuri care nu corespund intereselor sale, relatează UNN, citând Reuters.

lithuania.description: Donald Trump a cerut descalificarea candidatei democrate la Senat din Alaska, după dezvăluirile publicate de „The New York Times”, potrivit cărora echipa acesteia de campanie l-a încurajat pe un candidat cu același nume ca senatorul în exercițiu să candideze, pentru a „fura” din voturile republicanului ce încearcă să fie reales, transmite AFP. lithuania.description: Președinta Băncii Centrale Europene, Christine Lagarde, se va retrage din funcție în luna februarie a anului viitor, cu nouă luni înainte de terminarea mandatului său, potrivit unui comunicat al BCE citat de Mediafax. „Președinta Băncii Centrale Europene, Christine Lagarde, a informat astăzi Consiliul Guvernatorilor și președintele Consiliului European, António Costa, că se va retrage din […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: Estonia has run out of asphalt, says Tallinn deputy mayor
lithuania.description: Estonia is experiencing a shortage of asphalt as factories in Sweden and Lithuania are currently not supplying it to the country, Deputy Mayor Kristjan Järvan (Isamaa) has said

lithuania.title: Leedu tuvastas Starlinki seadmete süütamise katses kahtlustatavad kaks meest
lithuania.description: Leedu korrakaitsjad tegid kindlaks kaks Saksamaal elavat meest, keda kahtlustatakse selle kuu alguses Vilniuses Starlinki seadmete süütamise katses ning kes peeti Bulgaaria palvel kinni Saksamaal.

lithuania.title: POSTIMEES UKRAINAS ⟩ USA pakkus Ukrainale hunnikut pappi ja kaheraudset
lithuania.description: Pärast Trumpi-Putini diislidiili tekkinud pinged USA ja Ukraina vahel on mõnevõrra leevenenud, kuid USA surub endiselt Kiievile peale vastuvõetamatuid tingimusi. See teeb läbirääkimised sõja lõpetamiseks suhteliselt mõttetuks.

lithuania.title: Lithuanian minister hopes new government will help Latvia catch up on Rail Baltica
lithuania.description: Lithuanian Transport Minister Juras Taminskas said on Monday that he hopes the installation of a new government in Latvia will improve cooperation on the troubled Rail Baltica project, reports Lithuanian public media LRT.

lithuania.title: Tree friends hope to make more tree friends in western Latvia campaign
lithuania.description: In Kurzeme, local authority representatives, arborists and other interested parties are being taught to recognise the habitats of protected species in historic tree-lined avenues and parks. This is one of the public education initiatives taking place as part of the Latvian-Lithuanian cross-border project ‘Green Guardians’, Latvian Radio reported on October 27.

lithuania.title: Kremlis vēlas pārveidot NATO, liekot uz galda bīstamo 2021. gada plānu: ko tas paredz?
lithuania.description: Kremlis ir pavērsis skatu uz NATO un mēģina atdzīvināt bīstamu plānu, kas nav aizmirsts kopš 2021. gada – samazināt NATO klātbūtni Eiropā. lithuania.description: Krievija varētu gatavot jaunas provokācijas Eiropā, lai destabilizētu valstis un vājinātu atbalstu Ukrainai. lithuania.title: Socialiniai tinklai, viešas asmens duomenų skelbimas ir asmens duomenų apsauga
lithuania.description: Projekto „SolPriPa 3: Žinok savo teises ir pareigas“ tinklalaidėje „Socialiniai tinklai, viešas asmens duomenų skelbimas ir asmens duomenų apsauga“ aptariama, kaip socialiniuose tinkluose atsakingai skelbti ir naudoti kitų asmenų duomenis.

lithuania.title: Gitanas Nausėda: sienos intervencijos iš Rusijos pusės nėra atmestinos
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Gitanas Nausėda sako, kad Rusija per artimiausius dvejus nėra pasiruošusi plataus masto karui prieš NATO, tačiau vienybę gali išbandyti hibridinėmis atakomis, neatmestinos „sienos intervencijos“.

lithuania.title: Reikšmingi vaizdo stebėjimo aspektai
lithuania.description: Projekto „SolPriPa 3: Žinok savo teises ir pareigas“ tinklalaidėje „Reikšmingi vaizdo stebėjimo aspektai“ aptariami svarbiausi asmens duomenų apsaugos reikalavimai vykdant vaizdo stebėjimą.

lithuania.title: Valstybės gynimo taryba sutarė: visuotinis vaikinų šaukimas bus įvedamas nuo 2032 metų
lithuania.description: Iš šalies ir krašto apsaugos sistemos vadovų sudaryta Valstybės gynimo taryba ketvirtadienį sutarė Lietuvoje įvesti visuotinį šaukimą į kariuomenę nuo 2032 metų.

lithuania.title: Pakuotė gali būti perdirbama, bet likti neperdirbta: ekspertė įvardijo pagrindines priežastis
lithuania.description: Kasmet Europoje sunaudojami milžiniški kiekiai popierinių ir kartoninių pakuočių, tačiau ne visos jos sugrįžta į gamybą kaip nauja žaliava. Nors popierius laikomas lengvai perdirbama medžiaga, tam tikros pakuočių dangos, klijai ar kiti priedai gali apsunkinti jų perdirbimą. Pasak „Grigeo Recycling“ vadovės Justinos Prunskienės, tai, ar pakuotė bus perdirbta, nemaža dalimi priklauso nuo sprendimų, kuriuos verslas priima dar prieš ją sukurdamas.

lithuania.title: Į G20 grįžtanti Rusija jau žarstosi pareiškimais
lithuania.description: Didžiojo dvidešimtuko (G20) užsienio reikalų ministrų susitikime Jungtinėse Valstijose Rusijos diplomatijos vadovas Sergejus Lavrovas savo kalbą išnaudos pasisakymui prieš tarptautines sankcijas, ketvirtadienį paskelbė Maskva.

lithuania.title: „Aplink kalėjimą susirinkę pareigūnai, žvalgosi“: aiškėja, koks sujudimas vyksta Vilniuje
lithuania.description: Netoli sostinės centro esantį Vilniaus kalėjimą ketvirtadienio popietę apgulė specialiųjų tarnybų pajėgos. Sujudimas vyksta pagal planą – rengiamos pratybos.

lithuania.title: Kreipimasis į duomenų apsaugos priežiūros instituciją: kada ir kaip?
lithuania.description: Projekto „SolPriPa 3: Žinok savo teises ir pareigas“ tinklalaidėje „Kreipimasis į duomenų apsaugos priežiūros instituciją: kada ir kaip?“ kalbama apie tai, kaip tinkamai ginti teisę į asmens duomenų apsaugą.

lithuania.title: Vienas teismas nuteisė, kitas išteisino: Šiaulių politikas Gintautas Lukošaitis išgirdo sprendimą „čekiukų“ byloje
lithuania.description: Lietuvos apeliacinis teismas patenkino už piktnaudžiavimą tarnybine padėtimi, turto pasisavinimą ir dokumentų klastojimą nuteisto Šiaulių miesto savivaldybės tarybos nario Gintauto Lukošaičio gynėjo apeliacinį skundą ir politiką išteisino dėl visų jam pareikštų kaltinimų.
